text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having completed her warrior's journey, 
Symboli Kris S declared that in the name 
of her "revolution," she would prove her 
strength in the Japanese Derby to become 
the best of her generation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a prep race, she requested to enter the 
Aoba Sho, which shared the same distance. 
Together with her Trainer, she resolved to 
do what must be done and claim victory 
without fail.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, she was told by Tanino Gimlet that 
she would be running in the Satsuki Sho, 
the NHK Mile Cup, and the Tokyo Yushun 
(Japanese Derby).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Upon hearing that story, the Trainer 
speculates: could it be that Tanino Gimlet 
wants to prove her aptitude extends across 
both miles and medium distances?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S accepted those words. Yet 
regardless of who her rival might be, her 
mission remained unchanged. Her next 
target was the Aoba Sho.
